notes.title: Surveyor's Signature and Seal Disclaimer
notes.description: All surveys must be signed and sealed by the surveyor to be considered valid pursuant to Florida Statutes. This statement is required on all surveys.
notes.content: This {survey_type} is not valid without the surveyor's signature and seal. In print, only the raised surveyor's seal is valid. In electronic form, only a digital signature is valid.

notes.title: Purpose of Survey
notes.description: If the purpose of the survey is not clearly assumed from the title (such as 'boundary survey' or 'topographic survey'), a brief statement of the purpose of the survey should be included.
notes.content: The purpose of this {survey_type} is to {survey_purpose}.

notes.title: Bearing Basis Statement
notes.description: All surveys must include a statement of the basis of bearing used for the survey pursuant to Florida Statutes. This statement is required on all surveys.
notes.content: This survey uses a basis of bearing of {bearing_basis} derived from {bearing_description}. North is based on {north_reference} and uses {bearing_source}.

notes.title: Horizontal Datum Statement
notes.description: All surveys that show horizontal information or distances must include a statement as to the horizontal datum used for the survey pursuant to Florida Statutes. This statement is required on all surveys.
notes.content: This survey was based on {horizontal_datum} and was established {horizontal_datum_source}

notes.title: Vertical Datum Statement
notes.description: All surveys that show vertical information or elevations must include a statement as to the vertical datum used for the survey pursuant to Florida Statutes. This statement is only required on surveys that include vertical information.
notes.content: The vertical datum for this survey is {vertical_datum} and was established {vertical_datum_source}

notes.title: FEMA Flood Zone Statement
notes.description: All surveys that include flood zone information must include a statement regarding the FEMA flood zone designation pursuant to Florida Statutes. This statement is required on all surveys that include flood zone information.
notes.content: According to the FEMA FIRM Panel {fema_firm_panel}, effective date {fema_effective_date}, for the community of {community}, the subject property is located in flood zone(s): {fema_flood_zone}. {fema_LOMR_affects}of flood zone information shown hereon was taken from public FEMA GIS data and is not a substitute for an official flood zone determination.

notes.title: Source of Legal Description
notes.description: The surveyor must define where the legal description used for the survey was obtained pursuant to Florida Statutes. This statement is required on all surveys.

notes.title: Title Document Information
notes.description: All surveys must include information about the title document used as a reference for the survey pursuant to Florida Statutes. This statement is required on all surveys that reference a title document.
notes.content: This survey was prepared with reference to the {title_document} prepared by {title_company}, document number {title_document_number}, with an effective date of {title_document_effective_date}.

notes.title: Abstraction of Land Disclaimer
notes.description: All surveys must include a disclaimer stating that the survey is an abstraction of the land and does not represent a title search or opinion of title pursuant to Florida Statutes. This statement is required on all surveys that DO NOT reference a title document.
notes.content: This survey is an abstraction of the land and does not represent a title search or opinion of title. No attempt has been made to locate or identify easements, rights-of-way, covenants, restrictions, or other encumbrances that may affect the subject property.

notes.title: Property Access Disclaimer
notes.description: In boundary and ALTA surveys, we must state if the property has access to a right-of-way (either public or private) and if there is established water access to the property. This statement is required on all boundary and ALTA surveys.
notes.content: The subject property {has_access} access to {right_of_way_name} ({access_type} right-of-way){has_water_access}

notes.title: Non-Boundary Survey Disclaimer
notes.description: All surveys that are not boundary surveys must include a disclaimer stating that the survey is not a boundary survey and should not be relied upon for determining property boundaries pursuant to Florida Statutes. This statement is required on all surveys that are not boundary surveys.
notes.content: This {survey_type} is not a boundary survey and should not be relied upon for determining property boundaries.

notes.title: Possible Encroachments Disclaimer
notes.description: All surveys must include a disclaimer stating that the survey shows possible above-ground encroachments only and does not guarantee the absence of underground utilities or encroachments pursuant to Florida Statutes. This statement is required on all surveys.
notes.content: This survey shows possible above-ground encroachments only. No attempt has been made to locate underground utilities or encroachments. No guarantee is made that the subject property is free from encroachments, easements, or other matters that a title search would disclose.

notes.title: Corner Offset Disclaimer
notes.description: All surveys must include a disclaimer stating that north-south and east-west ties to recovered monumentation near specific land boundary corners shown hereon are by coordinate difference pursuant to Florida Statutes. This statement is required on all boundary surveys.
notes.content: North-south and east-west ties to recovered monumentation near specific land boundary corners shown hereon are by coordinate difference.

notes.title: Scaling and Measurement Disclaimer
notes.description: All surveys must include a disclaimer stating that the map may have been reduced in size from the original survey drawing and that it is the responsibility of the user to verify all dimensions and distances by scaling or measurement prior to use pursuant to Florida Statutes. This statement is required on all surveys.
notes.content: Attention is directed to that fact that this map may have been reduced in size from the original survey drawing. Therefore, it is the responsibility of the user to verify all dimensions and distances by scaling or measurement prior to use.

notes.title: Block Size Disclaimer
notes.description: All surveys must include a disclaimer stating that symbols depicted on the survey do not reflect actual size and that published dimensions take precedence over map scaling pursuant to Florida Statutes. This statement is required on all surveys.
notes.content: Symbols depicted hereon do not reflect actual size. Published dimensions precede map scaling.

notes.title: Jurisdictional Authority Disclaimer
notes.description: All surveys must include a statement indicating that the survey was conducted in accordance with the minimum requirements under Chapter 5J-17, Florida Administrative Code and may be subject to additional jurisdictional requirements pursuant to Florida Statutes. This statement is required on all surveys.
notes.content: This survey was conducted in accordance with the minimum requirements under Chapter 5J-17, Florida Administrative Code and may be subject to additional jurisdictional requirements.

notes.title: Heavy Underbrush Disclaimer
notes.description: If the land has thick vegetation or heavy underbrush that may have concealed evidence of encroachments, easements, property corners, or other matters, a disclaimer to this effect must be included on the survey pursuant to Florida Statutes. This statement is required on all surveys with thick vegetation or heavy underbrush.
notes.content: The land surveyed has thick vegetation or heavy underbrush that may have concealed evidence of encroachments, easements, property corners, or other matters that are relevant to the survey. The limits of this vegetation or underbrush are shown hereon where observed, but the absence of such limits does not indicate the absence of thick vegetation or heavy underbrush.

notes.title: Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE) Statement
notes.description: All surveys that include Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE) information must include a statement indicating the level of SUE performed, the provider of the SUE information, and a disclaimer regarding the accuracy and completeness of the SUE information pursuant to Florida Statutes. This statement is required on all surveys that include SUE information.
notes.content: This survey includes Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE) information in accordance with ASCE 38-22 standards. The level of SUE performed is Level {sue_level}, and was performed by {sue_provider}. This firm makes no guarantees regarding the accuracy or completeness of the SUE information provided and, unless otherwise noted, has not physically located or exposed any subsurface utilities.

notes.title: Aerial LiDAR Data Statement
notes.description: All surveys that include Aerial LiDAR data must include a statement indicating the scope of the LiDAR data, the type of data collected, the date of data collection, and the accuracy of the data based on conventional survey methods pursuant to Florida Statutes. This statement is required on all surveys that include Aerial LiDAR data.
notes.content: The {lidar_scope} shown hereon includes {data_type} collected on {lidar_date} with an accuracy of {lidar_accuracy} feet based on conventional survey methods. This data has been processed and classified to represent ground elevations only per ASPRS Standards. A quality control report has been provided to the client as part of the submittal package.
